dataset_replay_reason: Gohr dataset generation delegates to speck.make_train_data() (via GohrAdapter.generate_partition), which draws from os.urandom() internally. The integer audit/replicate seed does not control dataset content and cannot be used to deterministically regenerate a bit-identical dataset. The persisted dataset files, together with their file and logical content SHA-256 hashes (including a hash for every declared nested-prefix size), are the reproducibility/resumability object instead.
